title: Infrastructure Weekly Update - 2026-06-08
content:
Summary:
- Short week: focus on fleet stability post H100 rollout and regional capacity planning for Q3 commitments.
- Key wins: baseline autoscaler tuning rolled out to us-west1/us-east4 (H100 pools) - 8-12% lower tail latency under mixed workloads in internal perf tests.
- Key risk: memory leak observed in kernel-level driver on a subset of H100 instances (us-east4) causing OOMs under long KV-cache workloads.

GPU fleet status:
- Total GPUs (prod pools): A100: 420, H100: 260, L4: 120 (counts reflect physically provisioned GPUs across dedicated + hosted).
- New capacity added this week: +32 H100 (us-west1) for burst pool (INFRA-512).
- Utilization: avg 62% overall; peak 94% in us-east4 during customer X A/B tests on 2026-06-05.
- Observed issues: 2026-06-05 14:12 UTC - spike in 99th latency + increased OOMs in us-east4 H100 pool. Root cause prelim: kernel memory leak tied to CUDA driver version 525.x under long-lived model contexts (KV-cache heavy). See INFRA-503 for initial investigation notes.

Regions & routing:
- us-west1: healthy. Autoscaler tuning + prefix caching improvements showing 10% cost reduction in tests.
- us-east4: degraded last Wed-Fri due to above OOMs; we applied a temporary mitigation (restart policy + kill long-lived worker when tail latency > threshold). Full driver rollback scheduled.
- eu-west1: stable but approaching 75% utilization on A100 pool; recommend adding 24 A100s in July to meet EMEA demand forecast.
- ap-southeast-1: low baseline usage; we kept a small warm pool for private deployments.

Capacity planning (next 90 days):
- Q3 commit overview: Sales/Customer Success committed to 120 H100-equivalent reserved capacity across dedicated customers (onboarding cadence: 30% by mid-July, 70% by end-August).
- Immediate ask: provision +60 H100-equivalent capacity across us-west1/us-east4 to maintain SLOs during ramp. We plan to satisfy with mixture: 40 H100 (physical) + 160 A100 -> using quantization and model sharding to meet throughput (cost tradeoffs documented in Confluence runbook).
- Cost note: H100 spot availability inconsistent; pricing arbitrage suggests mixing A100 and L4 for embedding-heavy workloads. Updated cost model in PR #278.

Incidents & mitigation:
- INCIDENT INFRA-503 (2026-06-05): Kernel OOMs in us-east4 H100 pool.
  - Impact: increased 99th latency and intermittent request failures for customers on dedicated pools.
  - Mitigation taken: rolled back to CUDA driver 520.x on affected machines; applied aggressive worker restart policy; added alerting on per-GPU memory growth.
  - Next steps: rollout coordinated driver downgrade across all H100 nodes (planned 2026-06-10 02:00-05:00 UTC, low traffic window). Manual rollback playbook updated in linked Confluence page.

Operational changes deployed this week:
- Autoscaler tuning: reduced min_ready threshold and increased readiness_probe timeout for large-model workers (deployed us-west1/us-east4).
- Telemetry: added per-model long-lived context memory metrics (KV-cache growth) into Console for SRE + product owners.
- Canary policy: new fallback to A100-quantized variant for H100-limited routes when capacity < 10% free.

Standup highlights / meeting notes (Infrastructure weekly sync 2026-06-08):
- Attendees: Aisha, Marco, Evelyn, Rajiv, Samir, Lina (SRE), Priya (Product - hosting).
- Decisions: schedule three maintenance windows (US: 2026-06-10 02:00-05:00 UTC for driver rollback; EUR: 2026-06-17 01:00-04:00 UTC for node pool expansion; APAC: tentative week of 2026-06-22).
- Action owners assigned:
  - Marco: lead H100 driver rollback playbook & runbook updates (INFRA-503) - owner, due 2026-06-10.
  - Evelyn: provision 24 A100s in eu-west1 (cloud quota requests + procurement) - owner, due 2026-07-01.
  - Rajiv: update autoscaler logic + add unit tests for readiness transitions (PR #278) - owner, due 2026-06-15.
  - Samir: validate telemetry dashboards and add alert thresholds for per-model KV growth - owner, due 2026-06-12.

Open items / blockers:
- Cloud quota approvals for additional H100s in us-west1 stalled with cloud provider (ticket raised). Need escalation if not approved by 2026-06-12.
- Long-term: we need a deterministic way to pin CUDA driver across multi-cloud images to avoid drift; researching image bake pipeline options (investigation tracked INFRA-521).

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Evaluate opportunistic use of L4 for high-embedding, low-context workloads to reduce cost during ramp.
- Play with dynamic routing: route heavy KV-cache requests to dedicated pools with larger RAM/GPU memory; cheap embeddings to L4 pools.

Appendix - quick metrics snapshot (UTC 2026-06-08 07:00):
- Total requests (7d): 4.1M
- Avg token/sec per GPU: A100 38k, H100 54k, L4 22k (estimates from perf harness)
- 99th latency (tokens): A100 380ms, H100 220ms, L4 720ms

If anything missing ping me in #infra-weekly or drop a note on the Confluence page linked above.
